description.value:
Although it's no katana, it did belong to a Samurai. Infused with rage.

Category: Very Expensive • Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks

Fabrication Cost: Luxury

Class: Iconic EQ Very Heavy Melee • Skill: Melee • Range: Melee

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: N/A • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: No

Slots: None • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: When rolling for damage with this weapon, 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries. While the user is under the effects of any cyberware, street drug, or other item which puts them into a state of rage, and is rolling for damage with this weapon, 4s and 5s count as 6s for the purposes of incurring Critical Injuries, and when incurring a Critical Injury, it deals an additional 5 Bonus Damage (10 total).

Fabrication: DV24 - 2,500eb - 2 Weeks Fabrication Cost: Luxury
Range: Melee

Foundry notes:

  • Listed capacity is N/A; the sheet tracks 0.
  • Iconic weapons follow the Exotic weapon rules: no Non-Basic Ammunition and no Attachment Slots unless this entry says otherwise.
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Very Expensive benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
